77376.subject: The Smart Way To Use AI In Your Job Search, According To Experts
77376.body:
Forbes Edge

Автор: Forbes


Автор: Forbes

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/smart-way-use-ai-your-job-search-according-experts-forbes-magazine-h4ode?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BmCFLnQR%2BQ7aHQIZvilfAIQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=0LqKU0FFablYo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~msq5t5k3~vg-null-null&eid=fz96fz-msq5t5k3-vg
  
As artificial intelligence becomes a major part of the hiring process, many job seekers are asking themselves: How much AI is too much AI when applying for jobs? From being advised to use ChatGPT to help with your resume and cover letter, to hearing recruiters say they are tired of reading AI-generated applications, today’s professionals are being inundated with conflicting advice about how the technology may or may not aid their search.  To help clear the air, I spoke with AI experts and hiring managers about the ways in which they would and wouldn’t use AI if they were looking for a job themselves. Here are highlights from what they had to say. How To Use AI: For research: “I would use it to try to get a better understanding of the types of work that happen within the company and how they support people, because part of what you’re looking for are companies that are going to support long-term growth and skills development, which is what people really need,” says Brian Elliott, future of work strategist and CEO of the think tank organization Work Forward.  To improve your resume and cover letter: “AI can be used to tighten up your resume and it can be used to enhance your cover letter, but it still needs to be your own voice, and it still needs to be your own experiences on that resume,” says Margaret Burke, Principal, Talent Acquisition & Development Leader at PwC. To understand how the current market is impacting a company: Burke says that AI can also be helpful in providing job seekers with information about how a company is faring economically, which can give insight into whether the company is even worth applying to.  How Not To Use AI:  To write your resume and cover letter: Clara Shih, Founder and Executive Director of New Work Foundation, says that young workers with little experience in writing resumes and cover letters should steer clear of using AI to completely compose their documents. She says AI should only be used to help write your resume and cover letter if you already have the knowledge to “critique it, evaluate it, reject it, and judge it.” To generate text for a writing sample: Elliott warns that using AI to generate your writing sample and fill out your application entirely can backfire, as more hiring managers are developing an AI-induced hiring paranoia where they worry candidates are using AI to inflate their capabili

Автор: The Economist

Sign up for free here to receive this newsletter in your inbox every Saturday. You’ll also get our weekly newsletter with an exclusive introduction from our editor-in-chief. Earlier this year I found myself briskly walking across Helsinki to a gym where I met a small group of women in their late 60s or 70s. A physiotherapist was taking them through a workout. The walk, the workout and my earlier interview all had something in common. I had just met a Finnish health researcher running an experiment to see whether a combination of lifestyle changes and a common diabetes drug could reduce the risk of dementia. This trial follows groundbreaking research that has shed light on the remarkable drop in the age-adjusted rate of dementia in recent years. Exercise, it turns out, seems to play an important role in keeping our brains healthy. So does getting a shingles vaccine. 77372.subject: Aptos Flips the Script
77372.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

Today we look at how Aptos became one of the only general purpose L1s earning holders more than it pays operators, and the overhaul that flipped Token Holder Net Income (THNI) positive. On markets, the Crypto Equity Cohort leads everything on the back of Circle's 16.0% run, while BTC and most token sectors sit red ahead of this morning's July CPI print.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Yesterday we saw a boring tape, with the Crypto Equity Cohort (+2.9%) the standout while BTC slipped -0.4% and the S&P 500 idled -0.2% ahead of today's July CPI print. Only Oracle (+5.8%) printed a bigger number; Memes (+3.0%), Exchange Tokens (+2.5%), and RWA (+2.4%) followed, while DEXs (-4.1%), Privacy (-3.7%), and Solana Eco (-3.1%) anchored the red half.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e82ab1e7-eb8f-428d-ba55-6551425fe0a0/image.png?t=1786503346)
Caption: 

The weekly view makes leadership explicit. Crypto Equity Cohort leads everything at +12.0%, ahead of Oracle (+7.6%) and gold (+7.1%), while BTC (-0.7%), the S&P 500 (-0.4%), and most token sectors sit red; Solana Eco (-10.0%) and Crypto Miners (-11.2%) round out the bottom. The gold move was likely macro, as July payrolls[ showed](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-prices-today-friday-august-7-2026-gold-prices-continue-to-rise-even-after-july-jobs-report-misses-122102132.html) a 23K contraction versus an expected 80K gain, trimming the odds of a September Fed hike.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/4a4d98e8-8381-4dcd-973a-243a008635f9/image.png?t=1786503346)
Caption: 

Inside the Crypto Equity Cohort, this is largely a Circle story. CRCL gained 16.0% on the week; BLSH (+4.4%) and GLXY (+2.3%) chipped in, while FIGR (-4.0%) and GEMI (-3.2%) sat the move out. The broader Crypto Equities index added just 0.1%. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/48da3a29-8550-4a92-936d-c0202a30412a/image.png?t=1786503346)
Caption: 

Circle [reported](https://www.circle.com/pressroom/circle-reports-second-quarter-2026-results) Q2 on August 5, posting revenue and reserve income of $701M (+7% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $143M, USDC supply of $73.3B (+19% YoY), and $14.8T of onchain transfer volume (+151% YoY).
